name: nq-admin
description: Static website editor and lecture manager for nurulquran.com

scripts.build: node -e "const db=require('./lib/db'); const {buildAll}=require('./lib/build'); buildAll(db.load(), {siteDir: require('path').resolve(process.env.SITE_DIR || './site'), base: process.env.LECTURES_BASE || 'lectures'}); console.log('✓ Site built successfully');"
